## Page 9

Highlight  –Q4’2025 Awards & Recognitions  
Nov 27, 2025: TRIS Rating has affirmed the company rating on TTW 
Public Company Limited (TTW) and the ratings on its outstanding 
senior unsecured debentures at “AA-” with a “stable” outlook.
Dec 12, 2025: TTW received the highest "AAA" rating in the "SET 
ESG Ratings 2025" from the Stock Exchange of Thailand.
Dec 15, 2025: TTW was selected into the “SETESG Index ” for 
calculating the index during 1H’2026 by SETOct 29, 2025: TTW was evaluated on the “Corporate Governance 
Report of Thai Listed Companies 2025”  as “Excellent” by the Thai 
Institute of Directors (IOD) for 7 consecutive years.
Nov 25, 2025: TTW has received the "Sustainability Disclosure 
Award 2025" from the Thaipat Institute for seven consecutive years. 
This award recognizes TTW's excellent public disclosure of 
company performance and its coverage of Environmental, Social, 
and Governance (ESG) criteria.
Nov 2 7, 2025: TTW received two award plaques at the SET 
Awards 2025 event: the "Best Company Performance Award" and 
the "Outstanding Company Performance Award" . These awards 
were presented in the "Company Performance Awards" category for 
companies with a market capitalization of 30,000 to 100,000 MB.
Dec 3, 2025: TTW received a certificate of honor as a "Climate Action 
Leading Organization",  reflecting its commitment to reducing carbon 
emissions. Additionally, it supports operational goals in line with 
Thailand's target of achieving Net -Zero greenhouse gas emissions.
